svg.title: An external gateway authorizes every adapter ID before LoRAX resolves, batches, and serves it, and failures stop before scheduling.
svg.desc: Five ordered steps: an external gateway authorizes the adapter ID, LoRAX resolves it to a Hugging Face, Predibase, or filesystem source, a scheduler forms a heterogeneous batch across adapters, GPU inference applies each adapter over the shared base model, and the server streams output tokens back to the caller. Unauthorized IDs, incompatible artifacts, and load failures stop before scheduling.
